title: A protein approaching its steady state
caption: With production β = 10 nM/min and degradation α = 0.1 per minute, x(t) = 100(1 − e^(−0.1t)) climbs to x* = β/α = 100 nM, reaching half of it after ln 2/α ≈ 6.9 minutes.
alt: A rising curve of protein concentration from 0, passing 50 nanomolar at 6.9 minutes and levelling off at 100 nanomolar.
description: Production β = 10 nM/min and degradation α = 0.1 per minute balance at x* = β/α = 100 nM.
Starting from zero the protein follows x = 100(1 − e^(−0.1t)).
It is half-way (50 nM) at t = ln 2/α ≈ 6.9 minutes, a time set by the degradation rate.
